definitions: Direct the performance of (a musical work or an orchestra, choir, or other group).
Lead or guide (someone) to or around a particular place.
Transmit (a form of energy such as heat or electricity) through a conductor or by means of a conductor.
examples: The company conducts its business in a professional manner.
She will conduct the orchestra in a performance of Beethoven's Fifth Symphony.
A guide will conduct you through the museum.
